title: SCoPE-MS Protocol for Cell Sorting and Analysis
author: Bogdan Budnik
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgt4jwqw
materials: Conver up the plate and freeze until sorting.

Once the thermocycler has hit 90C and at least 5 minutes in the -80 have passed, put the plate into the thermocycler and hit resume (thermocycler will hold 90C for 10 minutes and then go to 4C) 00:10:00
Once the thermocycler has gone down to 4C remove the plate and spin it down.

steps.title: Prepare Plate
steps.instruction: Put 1ul of HPLC grade water into each well of a plate using the Nanodrop or a multi-channel pipette.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Sorting
steps.instruction: Process cells based on their type to prepare for sorting.

substeps.instruction: For suspension cells: Place 1 to 2mL of cell culture in an Eppendorf tube and proceed to the FACS sorting step.
For adherent cells: Wash with 2mL of PBS (for a 6mm plate) or 4mL of PBS (for a 10mm plate) at 37C.
Add 1ml of Acutase (for a 6mm plate) or 2ml of Acutase (for a 10mm plate) and incubate at 37C for 5 minutes.
Pipette Acutase around the plate to wash off all cells and collect them in a 2mL Eppendorf tube.
Spin down cells at 4C at 500 rcf for 2 minutes.
Remove supernatant without disturbing the pellet and re-suspend in PBS at 4C.
Spin down cells again at 4C at 500 rcf for 2 minutes.
Remove supernatant without disturbing the pellet and re-suspend in PBS at 4C.

steps.title: Sort Cells
steps.instruction: Sort cells using the FACS sorter, ensuring a bulk carrier is available for the sorted cells.

substeps.instruction: Place the plate into the -80C freezer for at least 5 minutes.
Turn on the HEATLYSE protocol (90C for 10 minutes) on the thermocycler and hit pause.

steps.title: Perform Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Prepare and run the trypsin digestion protocol.

substeps.instruction: If using 1 plate, prepare 120ul of a 200mM TEAB, 10ng/ul trypsin solution.
Dispense 1ul of this solution to each well (resulting in a 2ul reaction with a final concentration of 100mM TEAB and 10ng/ul Promega trypsin gold).
Run the DIGEST protocol on the thermocycler (37C or 45C for 3 hours depending on trypsin used, then cooling to 4C).

steps.title: TMT Labeling
steps.instruction: Label the digested samples with TMT tags.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 ul of the appropriate 85mM TMT label to each single cell well (Single cells: 127N, 128N, 128C, 129N, 129C, 130N, 130C, 131N, 131C; Carrier: 126; Reference: 127C).
Incubate samples for 1 hour at room temperature (22C).
Add 0.5 ul of 0.5% hydroxylamine to all samples and incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Pool Samples and Prepare for MS
steps.instruction: Combine the labeled samples with the carrier and prepare for mass spectrometry.

substeps.instruction: Add 1ul of bulk carrier (containing 100 cells worth of material labeled 126 and 5 cells of material labeled 127C) along with 0.5ul of 20% FA to one of the wells in the set.
Aspirate the contents of the well containing the carrier and FA and transfer it to the next well.
Continue aspirating and transferring the contents from well to well until the entire set is collected in the pipette tip.
Empty the material from the pipette tip into an MS glass insert.
Add water or evaporate the liquid until 12ul remain in the tube.
Place the insert in a labeled MS vial and cap with a pierceable cap.

steps.title: Mass Spectrometry Analysis
steps.instruction: Submit the sample to QE using the SC method, injecting 10 ul.
